hooks.command: bash -c 'CHANGED=$(git diff --name-only 2>/dev/null | grep "^fengyu-admin/src/"); if [ -n "$CHANGED" ]; then cd fengyu-admin && npx tsc --noEmit --pretty 2>&1 | head -30; fi'

bash -c 'BRANCH=$(git branch --show-current 2>/dev/null); if [[ "$BRANCH" == "main" || "$BRANCH" == "dev" ]]; then LAST=$(git log -1 --format=%s 2>/dev/null); if echo "$LAST" | grep -qE "^(feat|fix|refactor)"; then echo "[提示] $BRANCH 有新提交，可 /remote-deploy admin 或 /cloudbase-deploy 部署"; fi; fi'
